items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Benny Goodman, Jack Keygarten, they were in that band.

ctx.x: But he played saxophone didn‟t he?

Dexter Deal played saxophone, yes, and his father… he was musical director for it. But his father played violin. At the same time Ben Pollard had a band. Benny Goodman was in that band, Gene Crupa was in that band… no, Gene Crupa… Ben Pollard was a drummer. Benny Goodman, Jack Keygarten, they were in that band. Intermission was the same time. They would come over to the club to hear the sound and this… now with me, again after high school… where we‟d known one another in high school because even though we didn‟t…
Right, you were aware of them.
